40008641.author: पदार्थः
40008641.content: रौद्रेण by fierce, भुवि ground, पातितम्  thrown down, तं गृध्रम् that vulture, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, रामः Rama, मित्रसम्पन्नम् friendly, सौमित्रिम् Lakshmana, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40008641.author: Translation
40008641.content: Seeing the vulture lying on the ground thrown down by the fierce demon, Rama said to friendly Lakshmana:

40008642.author: पदार्थः
40008642.content: मम my, अर्थेषु in my objective, यतमानः while he is making efforts, अयं विहङ्गमः this bird, सङ्ख्ये in battle, राक्षसेन by demon, हतः struck, दुस्त्यजान्  hard to leave, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यति going to give up, नूनम् surely.

40008642.author: Translation
40008642.content: Struck down by the demon in the combat on my account this bird is going to give up his life which is indeed difficult.

40008643.author: पदार्थः
40008643.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अस्य his, अस्मिन् शरीरे in this body, प्राणः life, (अतिखिन्नः suffering from intense pain), विद्यते appears, तथा हि like that, अयम् he, स्वरहीनः faint voice, विक्लबः frightened, समुदीक्ष्यते feeling excruciating pain.

40008643.author: Translation
40008643.content: O Lakshmana, it appears he is frightened and is experiencing excruciating pain in the body. His voice sounds faint, too.

40008644.author: पदार्थः
40008644.content: जटायो Jatayu, पुनः again, व्याहरितुम् to speak, शक्नोषि यदि if you are able, ते भद्रम् be blessed, सीताम् about Sita, अख्याहि tell, आत्मनः yourself, वधम् striking, आख्याहि tell.

40008644.author: Translation
40008644.content: O Jatayu If you are still able to speak, tell me about Sita and about how you have been struck down.

40008645.author: पदार्थः
40008645.content: रावणः Ravana, किं निमित्तः for what reason, सीताम् Sita, अहरत् abducted, मया by me, तस्य his, किम् what, अपराद्धम्  crime, यम् which, दृष्ट्वा seeing, प्रिया beloved, हृता taken?

40008645.author: Translation
40008645.content: Why did Ravana abduct Sita? What fault did he find with me so that he kidnapped my beloved ?

40008646.author: पदार्थः
40008646.content: द्विजोत्तम best of birds, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् Moon like, मनोहरम् delightful, तत् मुखम् her face, कथम् how, आसीत् it was, तस्मिन् काले at the time of abduction, सीतया by Sita,  कानि what, उक्तानि did she say?

40008646.author: Translation
40008646.content: O best of birds how did her delightful, Moonlike face look when she was hijacked. What did she say at that time?

40008647.author: पदार्थः
40008647.content: सः राक्षसः the demon, कथं वीर्यः how powerful, कथं रूपः how did he look, किं कर्मा what he does, अस्य his, भवनं च mansion also, क्व च where, तात dear, परिपृच्छतः I am asking you, मे to me, ब्रूहि please tell.

40008647.author: Translation
40008647.content: O father  how powerful is that demon ? How does he look?What work does he do? Where does he dwell? Do answer my questions?

40008648.author: पदार्थः
40008648.content: अनन्तरम् incessantly, दीनात्मा a piteous soul, जटायुः Jatayu, विलपन्तम् wailing, रामम् to Rama, उद्वीक्ष्य seeing, अथ this, अतिसन्नया in a faint voice, वाचा spoke, इदम् these, अब्रवीत् said.

40008648.author: Translation
40008648.content: Thereafter Jatayu, a piteous soul, looked up at Rama who was  crying incessantly and said this in a feeble voice:

40008649.author: पदार्थः
40008649.content: सा she, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of demons, रावणेन by Ravana, वातदुर्दिनसङ्कुलाम् violent wind, विपुलाम् huge, मायाम् magic, आस्थाय creating, विहायसा in the sky, हृता taken away.

40008649.author: Translation
40008649.content: Ravana, the lord of the demons created violent winds through terrific magic and whisked her away in the sky.

40008650.author: पदार्थः
40008650.content: तात O my child, सः राक्षसः that demon, परिश्रान्तस्य when I was exhausted, मे myself, पक्षौ wings, छित्त्वा after cutting, वैदेहीम् princess of Videha, सीताम् Sita, आदाय taking,दक्षिणां दिशम् southern, प्रयातः went.

40008650.author: Translation
40008650.content: O my child  when I was exhausted, that demon cut off my wings and carried Sita off in the southern direction.

40008651.author: पदार्थः
40008651.content: राघव Rama, मे my, प्राणाः life, उपरुध्यन्ति obstructing, दृष्टिः sight, भ्रमति is reeling, अनुशीरकृतमूर्धजान् root hair grown on tops, सौवर्णान् golden , वृक्षान् trees, पश्यामि I see.

40008651.author: Translation
40008651.content: O scion of the Raghu race, I am gasping for breath. My eyes are reeling. I see root hair growing on the tops of golden trees.

40008652.author: पदार्थः
40008652.content: काकुत्स्थ O Rama, रावणः Ravana, येन मुहूर्तेन by such moment, सीताम् Sita, आदाय taking, याति he, अयम् this, विन्द: Vinda, नाम by name, मुहूर्तः time, विनष्टम् lost, धनम् wealth, तत्स्वामी that person, क्षिप्रम् quickly, प्रतिपद्यते will obtain, सः च and he, नाबुधत् did not know.

40008652.author: Translation
40008652.content: The time Ravana kidnapped Sita is known as 'Vinda'. The effect (of that time), is that her husband will regain his lost wealth. O scion of the Kakutstha race  he (Ravana )did not know it.

40008653.author: पदार्थः
40008653.content: राक्षसेश्वरः lord of the demons, रावणः Ravana, त्वत्प्रियाम् your beloved, जानकीम् Janaki, हृत्वा after carrying away, बडिशम् fish hook, गृह्य having picked up, झषवत् like the fish, क्षिप्रमेव quickly, विनश्यति will be destroyed.

40008653.author: Translation
40008653.content: Ravana, king of the demons, will perish soon for running away with your beloved Janaki just like a fish carrying away a fishhook (which causes its destruction).

40008654.author: पदार्थः
40008654.content: त्वया by you, जनकस्य सुतां Janaka's daughter, प्रति with regard to, व्यथा worry, न कार्या need not be, रणे in battle, तं राक्षसम् that demon, क्षिप्रम् soon, हत्वा having slain, वैदेह्या with Vaidehi, रंस्यसे will sport.

40008654.author: Translation
40008654.content: You need not worry about Janaka's daughter. You will soon enjoy the company of your beloved, Vaidehi after killing that demon.

40008655.author: पदार्थः
40008655.content: रामं प्रति with Rama, अनुभाषतः conversing, असम्मूढस्य of the bird that was not deluded, म्रियमाणस्य while dying, गृध्रस्य vulture's, आस्यात् from his mouth, सामिषम् mixed with flesh, रुधिरम् blood, सुस्राव dripped.

40008655.author: Translation
40008655.content: As he(Jatayu) was speaking to Rama with an alert mind even while dying, blood mixed with flesh started oozing from Jatayu's mouth.

40008656.author: पदार्थः
40008656.content: विश्रवसः Visrava's, पुत्रः son, वैश्रवणस्य साक्षात् Vaisravana's lawful, भ्राता brother, इति thus, उक्त्वा said, पतगेश्वरः Jatayu, the king of birds, दुर्लभान्  rare, प्राणान् life, मुमोच gave up.

40008656.author: Translation
40008656.content: Ravana was Visrava's son and Vaisravana's (Kubera's) brother, said Jatayu and gave up his rare life.

40008657.author: पदार्थः
40008657.content: कृताञ्जलेः waiting with folded palms, रामस्य Rama's, ब्रुहि ब्रुहि इति saying 'tell me, tell me', ब्रुवाणस्य as he spoke so, गृध्रस्य of the vulture, प्राणाः life, शरीरम् body, त्वक्त्वा after leaving, विहायसम् to the sky, जग्मुः went.

40008657.author: Translation
40008657.content: As Rama was saying to the vulture with folded palms 'Tell me, tell me'( about Ravana) the life breath of the vulture soared into the sky leaving the body.

40008658.author: पदार्थः
40008658.content: सः Jatayu, तदा then, शिरः head, भूमौ on the ground, निक्षिप्य after throwing, चरणौ feet, प्रसार्य stretching, स्वम् his, शरीरम् body, धरणीतले on the ground, विक्षिप्य scattering, पपात fallen down.

40008658.author: Translation
40008658.content: Then Jatayu dropped his head down, his feet thrown about, his body outstretched on earth.

40008659.author: पदार्थः
40008659.content: सुबहुभिः with much, दुःखै: with sorrow, दीनः dejected, रामः Rama, ताम्राक्षम् eyes red (with tears), गतासुम् with his life gone, अचलोपमम् looking like a mountain, तं गृध्रम् to that vulture, प्रेक्ष्य  seeing, सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.

40008659.author: Translation
40008659.content: Stricken with deep grief, his eyes red (with tears) Rama saw the vulture looking like a mountain. Seeing him dead, he said to Lakshmana:

40008660.author: पदार्थः
40008660.content: रक्षसाम् the demon's, वासे dwellingplace, इह here, दण्डकारण्ये Dandaka forest, सुखम् happily, बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, वसता living, अनेन by this, पक्षिणा by the bird, विशीर्णम् lost life.

40008660.author: Translation
40008660.content: Dwelling for many years happily in Dandaka forest, the abode of demons, the bird lost his life (on our account).

40008661.author: पदार्थः
40008661.content: अनेकवार्षिकः many years old, यः he, चिरकालसमुत्थितः lived for a long time, सः अयम् this Jatayu, अद्य now, हतः dead, शेते lying down, कालः time (fate), दुरतिक्रमः हि not possible to escape.

40008661.author: Translation
40008661.content: This Jatayu, who lived for long years, is lying dead now. (The dictate of) destiny is inescapable.

40008662.author: पदार्थः
40008662.content: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, सीताम् Sita, अभ्यवपन्नः he reached out for help, मे उपकारी my wellwisher, अयं गृध्रः this vulture, बलीयसा by the powerful, रावणेन by Ravana, हतः is killed, पश्य see.

40008662.author: Translation
40008662.content: O Lakshmana, see this Jatayu, my benefactor, killed by the powerful Ravana while he was reaching out to help Sita.

40008663.author: पदार्थः
40008663.content: अयं पतगेश्वरः this lord of the birds, पितृपैतामहम् ancestral, महत् great, गृध्रराज्यम् kingdom of vultures, परित्यज्य  left, मम हेतोः for my sake, प्राणान् life, मुमोच gave up.

40008663.author: Translation
40008663.content: This lord of the birds left his ancestral kingdom of viltures and gave up life for my sake.

40008664.author: पदार्थः
40008664.content: सौमित्रे Lakshmana, शूराः heroes, शरण्याः protectors, धर्मचारिणः rigteous people, साधवः good people, सर्वत्र all over, तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्वपि even among animals and birds, दृश्यन्ते खलु are seen.

40008664.author: Translation
40008664.content: O Lakshmana valiant souls and protectors, being righteous and honest are found even among animals and birds.

40008665.author: पदार्थः
40008665.content: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, सौम्य handsome one, गृध्रस्य bird's, विनाशे at his death, मत्कृते च for my sake, यथा as, सीताहरणजम् caused by the abduction of Sita, दुःखम् grief, तथाविधम् in that way, न not experienced.

40008665.author: Translation
40008665.content: O scorcher of enemies, O handsome Lakshmana the grief I experience due to Jatayu's death on my account is more intense than Sita's abduction.

40008666.author: पदार्थः
40008666.content: महायशाः illustrious, श्रीमान् prosperous, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, मम for me, यथा as, पूजनीयश्च worthy of reverence, मान्यश्च worthy of honour, अयम् this, पतगेश्वरः lord of the birds, तथा in the same way.

40008666.author: Translation
40008666.content: This lord of the birds for me is as worthy of reverence and honour as the famous and prosperous king Dasaratha.

40008667.author: पदार्थः
40008667.content: सौमित्रे Saumitri, काष्ठानि firewood, हर fetch, पावकम् fire, निर्मथिष्यामि I will rub, मत्कृते for my sake, निधनम् गतम् died, गृध्रराजम् king of the birds, दिधक्षामि I wish to burn.

40008667.author: Translation
40008667.content: O Saumitri  fetch firewood. I shall generate fire by rubbing them and cremate the king of the birds who has laid down his life for my sake.

40008668.author: पदार्थः
40008668.content: राघव O scion of the Raghu race, सौमित्रे Saumitri, रौद्रेण by the fierce, रक्षसा demon, हतम् killed, इमम् this, पतगलोकस्य नाथम् lord of the world of birds, चिताम् funeral pyre, आरोप्य placing, धक्ष्यामि I will cremate with honour.

40008668.author: Translation
40008668.content: O scion of the Raghus  I will place the body of the lord of the world of birds, killed by the fierce demon, on the funeral pyre and crimate him with honour.

40008669.author: पदार्थः
40008669.content: महासत्त्व very strong, गृध्रराज king of the birds, मया by me, समनुज्ञातः permitted, त्वम् you, यज्ञशीलानाम of those who perform sacrifices, या such, गतिः resort, आहिताग्नेश्च for him who kindles sacrificial fires, या गतिः attainment, अपरावर्तिनाम् of those who beat no retreat (from battle), या च and such state, भूमिप्रदायिनाम् for those who offer land in charity, या च that state, गच्छ go, मया by me, संस्कृतः च purified, अनुत्तमान् best of, लोकान् worlds, व्रज depart.

40008669.author: Translation
40008669.content: O mighty lord of the birds  by my grace attain the state of those who perform sacrifices, who kindle and maintain sacrificial fires, who beat no retreat from the battlefield and who offer land in charity. Purified by my offering of fire, you may depart for the best of the worlds.

40008670.author: पदार्थः
40008670.content: महासत्त्व very strong, गृध्रराज king of the birds, मया by me, समनुज्ञातः permitted, त्वम् you, यज्ञशीलानाम of those who perform sacrifices, या such, गतिः resort, आहिताग्नेश्च for him who kindles sacrificial fires, या गतिः attainment, अपरावर्तिनाम् of those who beat no retreat (from battle), या च and such state, भूमिप्रदायिनाम् for those who offer land in charity, या च that state, गच्छ go, मया by me, संस्कृतः च purified, अनुत्तमान् best of, लोकान् worlds, व्रज depart.

40008670.author: Translation
40008670.content: O mighty lord of the birds  by my grace attain the state of those who perform sacrifices, who kindle and maintain sacrificial fires, who beat no retreat from the battlefield and who offer land in charity. Purified by my offering of fire, you may depart for the best of the worlds.

40008671.author: पदार्थः
40008671.content: धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, पतगेश्वरम् lord of birds, चिताम् on the pyre, आरोप्य having laid, दुःखितः sorrowful, स्वबन्धुमिव like his own relation, ददाह cremated.

40008671.author: Translation
40008671.content: Thus said, righteous Rama laid him on the pyre and sadly cremated the lord of the birds as one would do to his own relative.

40008672.author: पदार्थः
40008672.content: अथ then, वीर्यवान् mighty, रामः Rama, सहसौमित्रिः with Saumitri, वनम् forest, गत्वा after going, स्थूलान् large, महारोहीन् stately deer, हत्वा killed, तं द्विजम् to that bird (Jatayu), अनुतस्तार spread it as offering.

40008672.author: Translation
40008672.content: Then the mighty Rama, accompanied by Saumitri, got into the forest and killed a huge deer, brought it and spread it as an offering (to the dead Jatayu).

40008673.author: पदार्थः
40008673.content: महायशाः famed, रामः Rama, रोहिमांसानि flesh of the deer, उत्कृत्य cutting to pieces, पेशीकृत्य making into balls, रम्ये in a lovely, हरितशाद्वले green, grassy land, शकुनाय the bird Jatayu, ददौ offered.

40008673.author: Translation
40008673.content: Tearing the flesh of the deer to pieces and making them  into balls, the celebrated Rama laid it on a lovely, green grassy land as offering to the bird.

40008674.author: पदार्थः
40008674.content: तत् that, यत् whatever, द्विजातयः brahmins, प्रेतस्य for the dead, मर्त्यस्य for a mortal, स्वर्गगमनम् for ascending to heaven, कथयन्ति they utter, तत् all that, पित्र्यम् pertaining to father, तस्य that, जजाप muttered.

40008674.author: Translation
40008674.content: Rama muttered the mantras recommended by brahmins for dead mortals as one would do for his father, to help him ascend to heaven.

40008675.author: पदार्थः
40008675.content: ततः then, उभौ तौ they both, नरवरात्मजौ two princes, गोदावरीं नदीम् to river Godavari, गत्वा after reaching, तस्मै for him, गृद्रराजाय for the vultureking, उदकम् libations, चक्रतुः offered.

40008675.author: Translation
40008675.content: Then both the princes went down to river Godavari and offered libations for the king of vultures.

40008676.author: पदार्थः
40008676.content: तदा thereafter, (तौ) राघवौ both scions of the Raghu dynasty, शास्त्रदृष्टेन as ordained in scriptures, विधिना duly, गृध्राय for the vulture, जले in water, स्नात्वा bathing, गृध्रराजाय to the king of vultures, उदकम् water, चक्रतुः offered.

40008676.author: Translation
40008676.content: Thereafter both the scions of the Raghu dynasty bathed in water, offered libations for the king of vultures as ordained in the scriptures.

40008677.author: पदार्थः
40008677.content: रणे in battle, सुदुष्करम् very difficult feat, यशस्करम् glorious, कर्म deed, कृतवान् done, निपातितः was made to fall, सः गृध्रराजः that lord of the vultures, तदा then, महर्षिकल्पेन following the prescription of sages, संस्कृतः sanctified, पुण्याम् holy, शुभाम् auspicious, आत्मनः his, गतिम् state, जगाम reached.

40008677.author: Translation
40008677.content: The king of vultures had performed a very difficult and glorious feat by laying down his life fighting. Sanctified by Rama's offering as laid down in scriptures by the seers, he attained a holy, auspicious and divine state of the self.

40008678.author: पदार्थः
40008678.content: तौ अपि they both, कृतोदकौ  offering libation, पक्षिसत्तमे to the great bird, स्थिराम् settled, बुद्धिम् mind, प्रणिधाय employing their attention, ततः then, सीताधिगमे to search Sita, मनः mind, प्रवेश्य  entered , सुरेन्द्रौ like two lords of gods, विष्णुवासवाविव like Visnu and Indra, वनम् forest, जग्मतुः went.

40008678.author: Translation
40008678.content: Rama and Lakshmana, like two lords of gods, Indra and Visnu, offered libations for the great bird with their settled minds and concentrated and then entered deeper into the forest turning their attention to the search for Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyeighth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
